floor_history.headline: Recon: honest floor 33 -> 15 pure-C (no cheats); entire residual is one loop.c decision (0x91A2B3C5 magic hoisted vs target's in-loop split lui/ori) plus its downstream mfhi-temp seat

Structural axis closed with two measured kills (do-while(0) inner loop is PHONY; +1 RTL insn costs ~6.5 score) — re-filed the bytes-proven INTEGRATION HANDOFF under a header the driver's regex accepts

frontier.hypothesis: The chassis, not the C, is the residual: our generic mips-mips-gnu cc1 has a live FP register file the PS1 R3000A does not have, giving loop.c a threshold of 122 where the original toolchain saw 58.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c:532 threshold = (loop_has_call ? 1 : 2) * (1 + n_non_fixed_regs); regclass.c:380-387 counts hard regs with !fixed_regs[i]; -msoft-float fixes the 32 FP regs via mips.h CONDITIONAL_REGISTER_USAGE
frontier.next_probe: Operator-only: elect the flag variant per docs/grind/decisions.md:19622, mirror it into engine/buildconfig.py, verify-oracle --rebuild, then apply candidate.c and expect sandbox 0.

frontier.hypothesis: If the global -msoft-float variant is elected, func_800324D0 (code6cac_b) regresses 0 -> 3 and needs an ordinary structural re-grind — its loop must be spelled at <= 58 RTL insns (currently 72) for its `li 255` hoist to survive at threshold 58.
frontier.mechanism: the same loop.c:1631 desirability test in reverse: 122 >= 72 hoists, 58 < 72 does not
frontier.next_probe: After any chassis change, queue reopen func_800324D0 and grind its loop body down to <= 58 RTL insns (read `Loop from ...: N real insns.` in the .loop dump as the gradient).

frontier.hypothesis: No further C search on func_8003C714 is warranted on the shipped chassis; all three inputs to loop.c:1631 plus every movable-admission escape are now enumerated from source and measured closed.
frontier.next_probe: None on the C axis. If a future session is dispatched here anyway, spend it on the chassis question (cc1 configuration fidelity), not on spelling.

judge_constraints: Grind func_8003C714 in ordinary C on the SHIPPED chassis only; CC_FLAGS / cc1 configuration / buildconfig are not a lever and may not be re-filed as an integration handoff or exhaustion claim.
